source: 620 Abnormality in the Abyss
target: 620 Abnormalitas in abyssō

source: “Could it be that some of the Demon legends in this notebook are true?” Lumian held the yellowed notebook and flipped through a few pages.
target: “Numquid quidam fabulae daemonum in hoc libello verae sint?” Lumian libellum flavum tenuit et per aliquot paginas volvit.

source: Franca tersely acknowledged and said,
target: Franca breviter annovit et dixit,

source: “In a world where superpowers exist, where true Devils and Demons roam, many related legends must be true or have originated from the true prototype.”
target: “In mundo ubi potentiae superae existent, ubi veri Diaboli et Daemones vagantur, multae fabulae cognatae verae esse debent aut ex prototypo vero orta sunt.”

source: “Do you think Nabo—uh, the Demon who claimed to be ancient, might be the protagonist of one of these legends?”
target: “Putasne Nabo—heu, daemon qui se antiquum esse professus est—fortasse protagonistam unius harum fabularum esse?”

source: “And the Demon on Hanth Island is its archenemy, living in the real world disguised as a human.”
target: “Et daemon in Insula Hanth est archinimicus eius, in mundo vero sub specie hominis habitans.”

source: “It lied, claiming the other party is a descendant of a Demon and tempted us into taking risks to achieve a certain goal?”
target: “Mendavit, dicens alterum daemonis posterum esse, atque nos ad pericula suscipienda ad certum finem incitavit?”

source: “Perhaps,” Lumian smiled.
target: “Fortasse,” risit Lumian.

source: “Let’s not speculate about such matters involving high-level creatures.
target: “Ne de rebus talibus, quae creaturae summi gradus attingunt, coniecturam faciamus.

source: “I’ll just write to Madam Magician and report it to her.”
target: “Modo ad Dominam Magicam scribam et id ea certiorem faciam.”

source: Franca glanced at Lumian and chuckled.
target: Franca Lumian intuens subridit.

source: “You’re really proficient in dealing with management.”
target: “Vere peritus es in rebus administrationis tractandis.”

source: “However, it does make sense.”
target: “Attamen, id perspicuum est.”

source: “We know very little about real Demons.”
target: “De daemonibus veris parum novimus.”

source: “Making wild guesses is a waste of time.”
target: “Coniecturae temere factae tempus inutile consumunt.”

source: She then pointed at the notebook and said,
target: Deinde ad libellum indicavit et dixit,

source: “The handwriting differs from the note that wrote the Love Incantation.”
target: “Scriptura differt ab illa notula, quae Incantationem Amoris scripsit.”

source: “It’s not the same author.”
target: “Non est eadem auctor.”

source: Lumian had already sat at his desk, unfolded a piece of paper, and wrote to Madam Magician.
target: Lumian iam ad mensam sedebat, chartam explicavit, et ad Dominam Magicam scribebat.

source: As he deliberated over his words, he responded to Franca’s words, “Does the notebook have the phrase that represents the Love Incantation?”
target: Dum verba sua meditabat, respondit ad verba Francae: “Continetne hoc libellus locutionem, quae Incantationem Amoris repraesentat?”

source: “I scanned through it. Nothing,” Franca replied affirmatively.
target: “Perlegi. Nihil,” respondit Franca cum assenso.

source: Lumian contemplated for a moment and said,
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus dixit,

source: “There are two possibilities.”
target: “Duae sunt possibilitates.”

source: “The first is that the Demon used someone under its control to insert the Love Incantation into this notebook that records Devil and Demon legends, hoping that it could secretly spread and affect more people.”
target: “Prima est, quod daemon aliquem, qui sub sua potestate erat, adhibuit ut Incantationem Amoris in hoc libello, qui fabulas Diabolorum et Daemonum continet, inscriberetur, sperans ea clandestine diffundi posse et plures afficere.”

source: “The second possibility is that those who once read this notebook were unknowingly influenced by the demon and obtained a so‑called revelation.”
target: “Secunda possibilitas est, quod illi, qui hunc libellum olim legerunt, daemonis incauti impulsu affecti sunt et revelationem adepti sunt.”

source: “They wrote this Love Incantation and provided commentary.”
target: “Hanc Incantationem Amoris scripserunt et commentarium praebuērunt.”

source: “Mysticism sure is dangerous…” Franca sighed with emotion.
target: “Misticismus certe periculosus est…” Franca cum affectu suspiravit.

source: Lumian swiftly composed the letter and dispatched the ancient notebook and the note with the Love Incantation to Madam Magician.
target: Lumian celeriter epistolam composuit et antiquum libellum atque notam cum Incantatione Amoris ad Dominam Magicam misit.

source: While awaiting a response, Franca and Lumian briefly delved into the Demon legend of Hanth Island in the Berserk Sea.
target: Dum responsum exspectabant, Franca et Lumian breviter in fabulam daemonum Insulae Hanth in Mare Furiato inciderunt.

source: Thirty years after Emperor Roselle discovered a safe sea route to the Southern Continent, numerous mysterious deaths of colonists and natives plagued the newly colonized Hanth Island.
target: Triginta annis postquam Imperator Roselle iter maritimum tutum ad Continens Meridiionalem repperit, multas mortes mysteriosas colonorum et indigenarum nuper coloniae Insulae Hanth affligebant.

source: Witnesses claimed to have seen a valley ablaze with sulfur flames in the island’s forest.
target: Testes affirmaverunt se vidisse vallem in silva insulae sulphuris flammis ardentem.

source: At night, pitch‑black Demons with goat horns were suspected of circling the area.
target: Noctu, daemones nigerrimi cum cornibus caprinis, regionem circumire suspicabantur.

source: After the authorities intervened, the mysterious deaths ceased.
target: Postquam auctoritates intervenerunt, mortes mysteriosas cessaverunt.

source: The owner of the notebook that chronicled the legend even attempted to explore the forest, but he failed to locate the alleged valley burning with sulfur flames.
target: Possessor libelli, qui legendam enarravit, etiam temptavit silvam explorare, sed non potuit invenire vallem, quae dicitur sulphuris flammis ardere.

source: As they conversed, time passed.
target: Dum colloquebantur, tempus transiit.

source: The doll messenger arrived with Madam Magician’s reply, the ancient notebook, and the Love Incantation note.
target: Nuntius simulacrum advenerat cum responsione Dominae Magicam, antiquo libello, et nota Incantationis Amoris.

source: Lumian illuminated the gas wall lamp and began reading.
target: Lumian lampadem parietalem gasiferam accendit et legere inchoavit.

source: Franca didn’t hesitate and leaned in.
target: Franca non dubitavit et se inclinavit.

source: “It’s impossible to determine its true name with just the fact that the name ‘Naboredisley’ could expel that fellow.”
target: “Verum nomen eius determinare impossibile est, solum ex eo quod nomen ‘Naboredisley’ illum expellere potuit.”

source: “This is because it admitted, in a short period of time, that it was its real name.”
target: “Hoc est, quia brevi tempore agnovit se verum nomen suum esse.”

source: “Even if it’s lying, sometimes, under certain circumstances, admitting something makes it the truth.”
target: “Etiamsi mentitur, aliquando sub certis condicionibus, aliquid agnoscere veritatem facit.”

source: “It possesses the corresponding mysticism connection. This is one of Mr. Fool’s authorities. Amon, too, could do it in the past.”
target: “Illud habet nexum mysticum congruens. Hoc est unum ex auctoritatibus Domini Stulti. Amon quoque hoc priore tempore id efficere potuit.”

source: “As you prayed directly to Mr. Fool and used his power to exorcize Naboredisley, it doesn’t matter if it’s its real name. It won’t affect the final outcome.”
target: “Cum directe ad Dominum Stultum oravisses et eius vim ad expellendum Naboredisley adhibuisti, non refert an hoc verum nomen eius sit; exitum finalem non afficiet.”

source: “Do you understand? Termiboros’s warning was correct. You have to be cautious even if it’s a false promise.”
target: “Intellegisne? Monitio Termiboros recte fuit. Caute agendum tibi est, etiam si falsa promissio sit.”

source: “If it’s truly a Demon and its true name is indeed Naboredisley, the problem ends up more complicated.”
target: “Si vere daemon est et verum nomen eius re vera Naboredisley est, quaestio magis intricata fit.”

source: “Since the Fifth Epoch, Demons active in the human world have either taken the form of Sealed Artifacts or come from Andariel, Beria, or Nois.”
target: “Ab Quinta Aetate, daemones in mundo humano actuantes aut formam artificiorum sigillatorum adepti sunt aut ex Andariel, Beria, aut Nois oriuntur.”

source: “Demons without surnames in their true names are often ancient or come from the Abyss where Devils and Demons reside. As for the Abyss’s current state, Emperor Roselle’s diary has mentions of it.”
target: “Daemones, qui in veris nominibus cognomina non habent, saepe antiqui sunt aut ex abyssō, ubi Diaboli et Daemones habitant, oriuntur. Quod ad statum actuosum abyssī attinet, diarium Imperatoris Roselle de eo mentionem facit.”

source: Upon reading this, Lumian turned to Franca.
target: Hoc legens, Lumian ad Francam se vertit.

source: In the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, he often observed others trading Emperor Roselle’s diary.
target: In Societate Investigativa Papionum Crispatorum, saepe alios diarium Imperatoris Roselle commutantes observavit.

source: When the April Fool’s members were still active, they would even recite the relatively comedic parts publicly.
target: Cum sodales Aprilis Stultorum adhuc actuosi essent, etiam partes ridicules palam recitabant.

source: However, having joined the transmigrator organization only recently, he had no interaction with translations from the past.
target: Attamen, propter nuper ad societatem transmigratorum iunxi, translationibus veterum nullam interactionem habebat.

source: He had no way of knowing what Abyss‑related matters the Emperor had recorded.
target: Nesciebat quae de rebus abyssī Imperator conscripserat.

source: Franca said with a solemn expression, “Emperor Roselle once found the entrance to the Abyss and conducted a thorough exploration.”
target: Franca, vultu solemni, dixit: “Imperator Roselle olim introitum abyssī invenit et explorationem accuratam egit.”

source: “As expected of Emperor Roselle,” Lumian praised instinctively and sincerely.
target: “Sicut exspectabatur, Imperator Roselle,” Lumian instinctu atque sincere laudavit.

source: There weren’t many people he admired—in fact, very few—but Emperor Roselle was one of them.
target: Pauci erant homines quos admiraretur—revera valde pauci—sed Imperator Roselle unus ex eis erat.

source: Knowing that this emperor was a transmigrator like his sister made him feel an affinity with him.
target: Cognoscens hunc imperatorem, sicut sororem suam, transmigratorem esse, ei affinitatem afferebat.

source: Franca continued, “In the Abyss that Emperor Roselle explored, Devils and Demons had long perished. Not a single one remained.
target: Franca continuavit: “In abyssō, quem Imperator Roselle exploraverat, Diaboli et Daemones diu perierant. Ne unus quidem remansit.

source: “All he saw before him were either corpses or silence.
target: “Omnia quae ante eum visa erant, vel cadavera vel silentium erant.

source: “This state made him feel fear. He left in a hurry without completing his exploration.”
target: “Status iste timorem in eum effecit. Festinanter discessit, explorationem non perfecit.”

source: “All dead?” Lumian frowned slightly. “Is the Love Incantation fellow either not a Demon or an ancient Demon from the Abyss’s core?”
target: “Omnes mortui?” Lumian leviter fronem contraxit. “Num ille, cui Incantationem Amoris refertur, vel daemon non sit, vel daemon antiquus ex centro abyssī?”

source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “If it’s really an ancient Demon, it might know why the Abyss underwent such an abnormality.”
target: Paulatim mora facta, addidit: “Si vere daemon antiquus est, fortasse sciat cur abyssus talem abnormalitatem passa sit.”

source: Franca nodded solemnly.
target: Franca solemni modo annuivit.

source: The duo cast their gazes at the back of Madam Magician’s reply.
target: Duo oculos in tergum responsionis Dominae Magicam intuebantur.

source: “I reckon you’ve already grasped the gist of the Abyss from the Two of Cups, so I won’t dive deeper.”
target: “Puto te iam essentiam abyssī ex Duobus Poculis intellexisse, ideo non altius penetrare.”

source: “Simply put, Naboredisley could be a potent Demon who slipped out of the Abyss’s anomaly, or it might have roamed the Northern Continent before the three major Devil clans—Nois, Beria, and Andariel—held sway.”
target: “Brevi dictum, Naboredisley fortis daemon esse potuit, qui ex anomalía abyssī effugere potuit, aut in Continente Septentrionali vagatus esse, antequam tres praecipua catervae Diabolorum—Nois, Beria, et Andariel—dominari inciperent.”

source: “It didn’t pledge allegiance to any ancient gods, whichever way you slice it. But dealing with an ancient Devil King who’s fled back to the Abyss isn’t something the two of you are capable of, let alone striking a bargain with it.”
target: “Nulli deis antiquis fidelitatem promissit, quocumque modo aspicias; sed cum antiquo Diabolo rege, qui in abyssum rediit, agere, id non est quod vos alteri valeatis, nedum pactum conficere.”

source: “You can explore the Demon legends on Hanth Island if it’s on your route, but stay cautious.”
target: “Poteris fabulas daemonum in Insula Hanth explorare, si iter tuum illuc ducat, sed cave.”

source: “Remember, the Abyss’s corruption is potent.”
target: “Memento, corruptio abyssī potens est.”

source: “It can corrupt people without their awareness.”
target: “Potest homines corrumpere subdoliter, ne conscii sint.”

source: “During this time, be vigilant for changes in your thoughts, concepts, emotions, and desires.”
target: “Hoc tempore, vigilare debes mutationes in cogitationibus, notionibus, affectibus, et cupiditatibus tuis.”

source: “If you notice anything unusual, consult a Psychiatrist for confirmation.”
target: “Si quid insolitum animadvertis, ad medicum psychiatrum consule ad confirmationem.”

source: “If you’re genuinely affected by the Abyss aura from Naboredisley, contact me or Judgment.”
target: “Si vere aura abyssī Naboredisley te afficit, me aut Iudicium continge.”

source: “Experts skilled in purifying such influences will assist you.”
target: “Periti, qui in purgatione talium influentiarum periti sunt, tibi auxilium ferent.”

source: “Avoid burdening Mr. Fool unnecessarily.”
target: “Noli inutile onus imponere Domino Stulto.”

source: “Thinking about the name ‘Naboredisley’ is okay, but refrain from writing or reading it.”
target: “Cogitare de nomine ‘Naboredisley’ licet, sed scribe aut lege abstine.”

source: After reading the letter, Lumian mumbled to himself, “Madam Magician seems more inclined to believe it’s a Demon and not some other hidden entity.”
target: Epistolam lecta, Lumian sibi submurmuravit, “Domina Magica magis inclinatur ad credendum quod daemon sit, et non quaedam alia entitas abscondita.”

source: “That’s right,” Franca echoed, puzzled.
target: “Recte,” Franca miratus replicavit.

source: “Let’s assume that fellow is a Demon, yet it doesn’t even have Danger Premonition, allowing us to complete the preparations for the Exorcism Spell. If we say it isn’t, it can create fluctuations and trigger our desires and emotions. I was just guessing that it’s a secret entity that possesses a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact of the Demon pathway.”
target: “Assumamus illum daemon esse, sed nec praenotatio periculi eum dotat, quae nobis parationes incantationis expulsionis complere sinat. Si dixerimus eum non esse, fluctus creare potest atque desideria et affectus nostros excitare. Modo conieci eum esse entitatem occultam, quae gradum unum artifacti sigillati viae daemonicae possidet.”

source: “Perhaps Madam Magician has seen more.”
target: “Fortasse Domina Magica plura vidit.”

source: “That fellow probably doesn’t have Danger Premonition because its true form isn’t here. It only descended with a sliver of its aura and power. Or perhaps, the danger originated from Mr. Fool, so it couldn’t sense it!”
target: “Verisimiliter ille non habet praenotatio periculi, quia forma eius vera hic non adsit. Tantum descendit cum minima particula aurae et potentiae suae. Aut fortasse periculum a Domino Stulto ortum est, ideo id sentire non potuit!”

source: “That makes sense,” Franca agreed before saying with a strange expression, “Ever since we became Minor Arcana cards, we’ve increasingly come into contact with the depths of the mystic world. The Demoness Sect, the mirror world, the War of the Four Emperors, the Great Mother, and a Demon of the Abyss this time… In the past, when I read Emperor Roselle’s diary, I often had the feeling that ‘that’s just how the world is.’ But now, the contents of his diary have truly come to us.”
target: “Id sensum habet,” Franca assensivit, antequam vultu insolito diceret: “Ex quo facti sumus chartae Arcanae Minores, magis in profundum mundi mystici incurrimus. Sectam Daemonissarum, mundum specularum, Bellum Quattuor Imperatorum, Magnam Matrem, et hoc tempore daemonem abyssī… Olim, cum diarium Imperatoris Roselle legebam, saepe mihi videbatur ‘sic tantum mundus est.’ At nunc, contenta eius diarii vere ad nos pervenerunt.”

source: Without waiting for Lumian to speak, Franca added in a self‑deprecating manner, “For example, a Demoness does taste pretty good.”
target: Sine exspectare Lumiano loquendum, Franca, seipsam contemnens, addidit: “Exempli gratia, daemonissa valde sapida est.”

source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “Think about it carefully. Did you encounter these things after becoming a Minor Arcana card holder, or after getting to know me?”
target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Cogita bene. Num has res postquam factus es possessor chartarum Arcanae Minores aut postquam me cognovisti, tibi occurrerunt?”

source: “Uh…” Franca’s lips twitched. “You know yourself well.”
target: “Heu…” labra Francae convulserunt. “Te ipsum bene nosti.”

source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
target: Directe autores in WebNovel sustenta!

source: Two days later, Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano boarded a long‑distance ship set to pass by Hanth Island, en route to the Southern Continent’s West Balam.
target: Duo diebus post, Lumian, Ludwig, et Lugano in navem longi itineris conscenderunt, quae Insulam Hanth transire destinata erat ad Balam Occidentalem Continens Meridionalis.

source: Lumian aimed to investigate the Demon’s legend and seize an opportunity to fully digest the Conspirer potion.
target: Lumian intendit legendam daemonis investigare et occasionem capere ad potionem Conspiratoris plene digerendam.

source: After outsmarting Naboredisley and banishing it with the Exorcism Spell, Lumian realized that his potion digestion had made significant progress.
target: Postquam Naboredisley callide superavit et incantatione expulsionis eum depulit, Lumian animadvertit potionis suae digestionem progressum significativum attulisse.

source: With another decent performance, he could advance the digestion further. This would eliminate the need for the final advancement ritual’s aid, allowing him to plan the subsequent matters more calmly.
target: Cum alia decente demonstratione, digestionem ulterius progredi posset. Hoc necessarium auxilium ritus ultimi evelleret, ut subsequentia res tranquillime disponeret.

source: Captain Pedro, accompanied by his eldest daughter Salah, and a few Favored and Blessed, expressed sincere gratitude to Lumian.
target: Capitaneus Pedro, comitatus filia sua maior Salah, et pauci Electi et Benedicti, Lumiano sincera gratias egit.

source: They watched as he ascended the gangway with his godson and servant, boarding the ship named ‘Berries.’
target: Spectabant eum ascendere scalas navis cum filio et servo, conscendens in navem, quae “Berries” nominata est.

source: Once the ship set sail, one of the Blessed appeared to sigh in relief and commented, “He’s finally left Port Colla…”
target: Postquam navis profectus est, unus ex Benedictis apparuit suspirare leviter et dixit: “Denique Portus Colla reliquit…”

source: Without waiting for Salah to inquire about the reason for the sigh, the Blessed, wearing a brown priest’s robe, turned to her and Pedro and advised,
target: Sine exspectare ut Salah quaereret rationem suspirii, unus ex Benedictis, veste sacerdotali fusca indutus, ad eam et Pedrum conversus suadebat,

source: “The circumstances at the scene of Flores’s death indicate that this matter involved a true, high‑ranking Demon. Miss Salah, it’s best if you stay in the cloister for a year to avoid any possible aftereffects.”
target: “Circumstantiae in loco mortis Flores ostendunt hanc rem involvisse verum daemonum altum ordinem. Domina Salah, optimum est ut in claustro maneas per annum, ne quid postea eveniat.”

source: Salah, aware of her awakening thanks to the adventurer Louis Berry’s assistance, was horrified. However, lacking personal experience, she inquired, “A year? A real Demon… What kind of Demon is that?”
target: Salah, auxilio Ludovici Berry percepta, horrida fuit. Sed, experientia carens, interrogavit: “Per annum? Verus daemon… Qualis daemon iste est?”

source: The Blessed, in a brown clergyman’s attire, responded solemnly, “It’s the Demons from the legends you’ve heard of, or something even more powerful.”
target: Unus ex Benedictis, veste sacerdotali fusca indutus, solenniter respondit: “Daemones sunt ex fabulis quibus audivistis, aut aliquid etiam potentius.”

source: “Wh…” Salah turned to her father with a face filled with fear, confusion, and disbelief.
target: “Quid…” Salah ad patrem se vertit, vultu metu, confusione, atque incredulitate pleno.

source: “Did you guys save me from such a Demon?”
target: “Num vos me e tali daemonis effugeritis?”

source: Pedro was equally surprised.
target: Pedro aeque miratus est.

source: He had never imagined that his daughter’s situation would involve such a terrifying existence.
target: Numquam putavit rem filiae suae talem existentiam terribilem amplexuram esse.

source: And Louis Berry had only received 20,000 gold risot!
target: Et Ludovicus Berry solum 20,000 aureorum “risot” accepit!

source: No, he actually succeeded!
target: Minime, re vera prospere obtinuit!

source: Pedro, having witnessed the adventurer Louis Berry’s strength through the colossal wave he created, could now grasp his power more vividly in this direct comparison.
target: Pedro, viatoris Ludovici Berry vim per ingentem undam quam creavit perceptus, nunc eius potentiam in hac comparatione directa clariorem sensus est.

source: In the first‑class cabin suite aboard the Berries.
target: In cella primae classei in nave “Berries.”

source: Lumian handed the ancient notebook and the note with Love Incantation to Ludwig and asked with a smile, “Is it edible?”
target: Lumian antiquum libellum et notam cum Incantatione Amoris ad Ludovicum tradidit et cum subridente quaesivit, “Estne edule?”
